stem.en: ABC Bakery bakes 40 cakes a day. Each cake costs ₹150 to make, and all 40 are sold at ₹220 each. What profit do the cakes make for the day, before rent and other running costs, in rupees?

explanation.en: Each cake leaves ₹220 - ₹150 = ₹70. For 40 cakes, the profit on the cakes, before rent and other running costs, is 40 × ₹70 = ₹2,800.

hints.en: First find what one cake leaves: ₹220 minus ₹150.
Then multiply by the 40 cakes sold.
